hero.title: See where public money goes—and the evidence behind it.
hero.description: Explore local budgets, follow projects from allocation to payment, and ask clear questions in English, Nepali, or Romanized Nepali.
hero.safety: Budget Darpan does not accuse. It identifies patterns and evidence that may require further review.

visual.label: Illustration of the Budget Darpan evidence trail
visual.title: From promise to public evidence

allocation.title: Budget allocation
allocation.description: Exact amounts come from structured, traceable records.

project.title: Project and contract
project.description: Available procurement records stay connected; missing records remain visible as evidence gaps.

payment.title: Payment and progress
payment.description: Reported spending is shown separately from unknown data.

evidence.title: Documents and citizen evidence
evidence.description: Every narrative claim can lead back to its source.

journey.title: A single story instead of disconnected spreadsheets.
journey.description: Budget Darpan connects allocations, projects, procurement, payments, official progress, documents, and verified citizen feedback so a citizen can understand the full context without becoming a financial analyst.

principles.title: Built for questions that deserve careful answers.

numbers.title: Numbers from the database
numbers.description: Financial totals use relational records and decimal arithmetic. The AI never invents or calculates official values.

citations.title: Claims linked to sources
citations.description: Document answers preserve title, page, section, fiscal year, municipality, and source link whenever available.

anomalies.title: Patterns, not accusations
anomalies.description: Every indicator explains the rule, threshold, data used, possible explanations, and recommended next step.

list.title: Explore reviewed municipal money and the projects it can support.
list.description: Select a municipality to see reviewed budget and spending evidence. Where project-level records exist, open their complete money trail and citations.

compare.title: Compare only what the records actually report.
compare.description: Known allocations are charted from the relational database. Unknown contract, payment, and progress values stay visibly unknown.

map.title: See projects with verified coordinates.
map.description: Map markers appear only when a source-backed project location exists. Missing coordinates are shown as a data gap, never guessed.

discovery.evidenceBoundary: Totals include only reported numeric values. Unknown amounts are counted separately and never converted to zero.
discovery.loading: Loading project records and structured totals…

municipalityEvidence.description: These are municipality or sector totals, not invented project values. They remain useful while individual project allocation, contract, payment, and location records are reviewed separately.

municipalityEvidence.projectTitle: Municipality totals found; project breakdown is still being reviewed
municipalityEvidence.projectBoundary: Budget Darpan will not turn these municipality totals into fake projects. Named projects will appear here only after their allocation, status, and source pages are safely linked.

project.errorTitle: The project record could not be loaded.
project.errorDescription: The evidence service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly; public source links remain available.
project.progressNotPublished: The cited source reports implementation activity but does not publish a numeric completion percentage.
project.reportedBalanceNote: Requires both a reported contract amount and reported payments
project.notReported: No payment data has been reported for this project.
project.procurementNotReported: No procurement notice has been found for this project.
project.awardNotReported: No contract award has been found for this project.
project.moneyTrailDescription: Each step stays linked to the same project so amounts, dates, contractor details, payments, and milestones can be checked in context.
project.chartEmpty: No comparable allocation, contract, or payment values have been reported.
project.chartBoundary: Only published amounts are plotted. A missing contract or payment amount is not treated as zero.

project.mapUnavailable: No coordinates have been reported for this project.

coverage.title: What is verified—and what record is still needed
coverage.description: A published date proves that a process event was recorded. It does not prove the corresponding amount or completion percentage.
coverage.notFound: No deliberately linked record has been found.
coverage.agreementMissing: No agreement date has been found in the linked evidence.
coverage.monitoringMissing: No monitoring date has been found in the linked evidence.
coverage.procurementReported: An official procurement notice is linked to this project.
coverage.procurementMissing: No separate procurement notice has been linked; this may have used a non-tender implementation route.
coverage.contractReported: An awarded contract and contract amount are published.
coverage.contractMissing: No award or signed contract amount has been found.
coverage.paymentDateOnly: The official table records {{date}} BS as the payment date, but does not publish the amount.
coverage.paymentMissing: Neither a payment date nor a payment amount has been found.
coverage.progressStatusOnly: The official status is “{{status}}”; no numeric completion percentage is published.
coverage.progressMissing: No official physical-progress record has been found.
coverage.nextTitle: Records needed to complete this money trail
coverage.nextDescription: These gaps cannot be solved with AI inference. Add the corresponding official record and cite the exact page or transaction.

required.contract: Signed agreement or award record showing the implementation method, responsible party, and agreed amount.
required.payment: Final payment voucher or project-level SuTRA transaction detail showing the actual paid amount.
required.completion: Monitoring report, measurement book, or completion certificate showing physical progress or completed quantity.

paymentStatus.date_reported_amount_missing: An official payment date is recorded, but the amount is not published
paymentStatus.not_yet_reported: Payment information is not yet reported

project.milestonesUnknown: No official milestone or physical-progress record has been found yet.

investigator.title: Ask where the project money went
investigator.standaloneTitle: Investigate a complete project money trail.
investigator.standaloneDescription: Explore the clearly labelled synthetic reference project, or open an official project to investigate only within its available evidence.

evidence.title: Source documents and citations
evidence.description: Project evidence is linked deliberately by claim type, page, section, and official source. A municipal document is never treated as proof of an unrelated project figure.
evidence.syntheticBoundary: This project contains synthetic demo figures. Official municipal documents may provide context, but they are not proof of those synthetic amounts.
evidence.error: Linked evidence is temporarily unavailable. The project money trail remains accessible.
evidence.empty: No source document has been linked to this project yet.

documents.title: Government documents with page-level traceability
documents.description: Each original PDF is preserved, hashed, extracted page by page, and marked for review when OCR or text quality is uncertain.
documents.error: The source library could not be loaded.
documents.detailError: This source document could not be loaded.
documents.empty: No source documents are registered yet. Run the evidence ingestion command after seeding the database.
documents.landingPageWarning: The manifest currently records an official listing page; the exact attachment URL still requires verification.
documents.fileUnavailable: The preserved local source is not available in this environment.
documents.openPreserved: Open preserved source in a new tab
documents.pagePending: This page has not been extracted or accepted yet.
documents.pagePendingHelp: The original source remains viewable on the left. Only reviewed or accepted text is added to the AI knowledge base.

account.title: Sign in without closing public access.
account.description: Browsing stays public. An account is required only for accountable actions such as verified project feedback.
account.boundary: Authentication proves control of this account. It is separate from mock citizenship verification.
account.error: The account request could not be completed. Check the details and try again.

verification.title: Verify one mock citizen identity.
verification.description: The identity provider matches synthetic credentials, issues a one-time code, and signs a short-lived assertion for Budget Darpan.
verification.mockBoundary: This independent test provider is not Nagarik App or official government verification. All supplied identities are fictional test records.
verification.oneIdentityBoundary: Creating another email or username cannot create another verified rating: one signed demo identity maps to one privacy-preserving citizen key.
verification.serviceError: The verification service is temporarily unavailable.
verification.demoCredentials: Demo: 9800000001 · TEST-PKR-0001. These values are sent directly to the separate mock provider.
verification.matchError: The demo identity could not be matched.
verification.identityLinked: This demo identity is already linked to another account. Use that account; a second email cannot claim the same identity.
verification.otpError: The code is invalid, expired, or already used.
verification.successDescription: {{username}} can now submit one accountable rating per project.

accountPage.title: Your accountability account
accountPage.guest: Public evidence is available without an account. Sign in only to save history or submit accountable feedback.

anomalies.title: Patterns and evidence gaps that deserve review.
anomalies.description: Every indicator is produced by a deterministic rule and shows the data, reliability, possible explanations, recommendation, and available sources.
anomalies.safety: Budget Darpan does not accuse. It identifies patterns and evidence that may require further review.
anomalies.empty: No active indicators match the available data.
anomalies.emptyProject: No active review indicator is recorded for this project.

accountability.title: Rules explain the concern; verified citizens add local evidence.
accountability.description: Automated indicators remain separate from citizen ratings, and neither is presented as proof of corruption.

documentReview.title: Approve OCR text before it enters retrieval.
